assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const s = $json.properties?.Date?.date?.start || ''; const e = $json.properties?.Date?.date?.end || ''; if (!s) return ''; if (!s.includes('T')) { const base = (e || s).slice(0,10); const d = new Date(base + 'T00:00:00Z'); d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate() + 1); return d.toISOString().slice(0,10); } return e || new Date(new Date(s).getTime() + (($json.properties?.['Estimate (min)']?.number || 30) * 60000)).toISOString(); })() }}

assignments.name: weekday
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const s = $json.properties?.Date?.date?.start || ''; if (!s) return ''; const anchor = s.includes('T') ? s : s.slice(0,10) + 'T12:00:00+05:00'; return new Date(anchor).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { weekday: 'long', timeZone: 'Asia/Karachi' }); })() }}

assignments.name: calendarTitle
